name: hud_sensor_tracker_load_objectives_from_zrd
description: HudSensorTracker::LoadObjectivesFromZrd binds objective review/read/complete/incoming sounds from the loaded objective ZRD tree, installs the read-sound event callback, handles the network early return, and selects the first incomplete objective. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudSensor objective-loading and HUD source-cluster pass.
Reconstruction remains limited where Binary Ninja renders zReader value-union nodes and objective path node resolution less clearly than source-level structures.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x418230 validates REVIEW_SOUND lookup, network-enabled early return after review sound binding, OBJECTIVEn iteration, ACTIVE/INACTIVE path resolution, READ_SOUND sample lookup, zSndSample::SetPlaybackEventHandler(OnObjectiveReadSoundEvent), raw read-sound delay assignment when the node field count is greater than 2, OBJECTIVE_SOUND lookup, snd_incoming lookup, and FindAndHighlightFirstIncompleteObjective.

The native LoadObjectivesFromZrd smoke directly supplies an in-memory zReader tree and zSound registry, then verifies review/read/complete/incoming sound binding, playback-event callback installation, read-sound delay assignment, first-incomplete selection, and the network early-return behavior.
